description: This file contains implementation of a Demangling class used for demangling C++ symbol names, along with utility functions for extracting class names and file names, and for logging messages. It references external headers and implements methods for name demangling on Linux and Windows platforms.

classes.name: Demangling
classes.description: A utility class for demangling C++ symbol names, providing methods to extract class names, class name only, and handle platform-specific name demangling.

methods.name: Demangled
methods.description: Demangles a given symbol name into a human-readable form, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: ClassName
methods.description: Returns the demangled class name from a mangled name.

methods.name: ClassNameOnly
methods.description: Extracts only the class name part from a fully qualified demangled name.

methods.name: FileNameOnly
methods.description: Extracts the filename from a full file path.

methods.name: LogMessage
methods.description: Creates a formatted log message string with filename, line number, and message.
